title: Classic Jigsaw
description: Unwind with crisp interlocking jigsaw puzzles—drag curved pieces across the table, snap matching edges together, and reveal vibrant full-screen illustrations.
controls: Drag scattered jigsaw pieces onto their matching positions on the board; correctly placed neighbors lock together smoothly.

zh-CN.title: 经典拼图游戏
zh-CN.description: 轻松治愈的经典拼图体验：拖动精美插画碎片对准凹凸接口咔哒拼合，一步步还原完整高清大图。
zh-CN.controls: 拖动散落的拼图碎片至正确位置，相邻正确碎片会自动吸附锁定，拼完一整幅画即通关。
